mechanism.mechanism_of_action: Antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) that delivers deruxtecan (topoisoisomerase I inhibitor) directly to HER2-expressing tumor cells, causing DNA damage and apoptosis

clinical.indications: HER2-positive breast cancer, HER2-low/ultralow breast cancer, gastric cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer

market.market_position: Leading HER2-targeted ADC, blockbuster status, FDA priority review for early breast cancer (2026) [uncertain]
